title: The US is deploying launch systems that are prohibited by the INF Treaty
text: EUvsDisinfo – przypadek dezinformacji: The US is deploying launch systems that are prohibited by the INF Treaty. SUMMARY In military sites in Romania and Poland, the US is deploying launch systems that are capable of launching cruise missiles such as the Tomahawk, which is prohibited by the INF Treaty. RESPONSE
